items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR, within 90 Days of hire.

3 Years of experience in high-acuity specialty setting for example: Pulmonology, Oncology & Hematology, Infusion, Maternal & Fetal Medicine, Neonatology, Gynecologic Oncology, Neurosurgery, Surgical Oncology, Peds Cardiology.
Serve as Clinic Navigator to an assigned Provider throughout the course of the patient’s care, ensuring a smooth and efficient patient journey in a high-acuity environment.
Prepare exam rooms, take vital signs, maintain proper inventory levels, and manage supply replenishment.
Accurately record data in medicine logs and other essential clinical documentation.
Perform specialty-related functions in the clinic requiring knowledge and integration of standards of care, data management, and independent judgment. Examples include, but are not limited to:
Arranging for genetic testing and managing results.
Assistance with high-level procedures (e.g., deep joint injections, ultrasounds, bone marrow aspirations, lumbar punctures, and biopsies).
Expertly manage clinical documentation within the Electronic Medical Record (EMR).
Accurately enter data into patient records and charts, ensuring comprehensive and up-to-date information.
Act as a "super-user," efficiently and effectively navigating the clinic’s assigned medical record system.
Identify normal and abnormal symptomatology through high-acuity environment experience.
Report specific urgent symptoms to the Provider STAT and ensure a closed communication loop on all urgent symptoms and critical lab results.

Interface daily with multidisciplinary clinical teams (e.g., pharmacy, chemotherapy, infusion nursing, hospital teams including OR and Imaging) to ensure successful scheduling of complex patient needs (e.g., blood transfusions, hydration, ER admission, hospital admission, STAT imaging/lab, home health/hospice).
Successful completion of a Medical Assistant Training Program.
